title: Construct a resonant partial target channel at every even width
body:
The fixed-original-owner obstruction in #4751 leaves a changed original-owner query as a concrete continuation. This package changes the second paid pencil from `P+2Q` to `P+Q` and constructs an exact free decoder with zero fresh-owner contamination. It yields a pure partial `A_f K_f x` channel after the retained five-call preparation.

The finite word certificate keeps central phases and proves the identity at every positive tensor width. Its exact trace-power formula is

`||A_f||²_HS = 8^f+(-8)^f-20(2^f+(-2)^f)+32(1+(-1)^f)`.

Consequently the channel is nonzero precisely at positive even widths. Its rank is one at width two. Every emitted free monomial is certified as an affine address permutation with linear/even-quadratic phase, so the constructive result uses the actual free alphabet rather than the predecessor's enlarged obstruction alphabet.

Original `x,y`, the fresh projector's whole complement, and dirty intermediates remain retained. This is a partial linear identity, not a full `Kx,Ky` unit or admission under an invertible-pencil/full-rank preparation contract. Physical preparation, routing/storage, missing target coordinates, complement recovery, terminal frames, cleanup and recursive supplier costs remain open. No new κ, selected-frontier change or paid saving is claimed.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19131473 . Exact predecessor sources and changed premise are pinned in `SOURCES.json` and `TASK.json`. Credit Yiyang's phase-prefix repair and continuation, lee-phys's two-image prefix, Jacob Sussman's small-unit model and the retained source lineage. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate agent's proof/code review.
